missingness.root_cause_status: The run logs preserve wrapper failure markers and partial progress but no exception/root-cause text for the eight campaign failures. The campaign report labels them HELICS timeouts; that mechanism is not independently recoverable from the retained per-condition logs.

controller.official_helics_period_semantics: Granted times are constrained to n*period + offset. Requests at invalid times advance to the next allowed time.
controller.verdict: The source executes 10-second logical decisions, but period=60 constrains HELICS grants to 60-second multiples. The loop can execute multiple logical decisions against one granted time and stale physical inputs. Retained campaign artifacts contain no successful controller grant/decision trace to demonstrate an actual 10-second physical defender cadence.

llm_max_tokens.verdict: The campaign attacker implementations hard-code 4000 and do not read experiment.yaml's 300 value; the YAML is stale/misleading rather than the effective campaign token limit.

interpretation_limits: Run is the experimental unit; timesteps are not treated as independent.
The campaign is unbalanced and lacks complete paired seeds across attacker cells.
Exact permutation tests are independent-label tests, not paired tests.
Bootstrap intervals are descriptive with N=3-5 and should not be read as precise.
Hour 14 is a ceiling/negative-control condition and excluded from responsive H1 multiplicity adjustment.
No missing TVD is imputed; worst-case bounds use only the physical [0, 300] range.
The controller timing verdict is based on source/config semantics because successful granted-time traces were not retained.
